items.title: Vivek Ramaswamy nearly drops a kid at a Trump rally: "Big guy!"
items.summary: At a Trump rally in Vandalia, Ohio, gubernatorial candidate Vivek Ramaswamy called 10-year-old Hunter up to the podium, announced "I'm going to pick you up" and hoisted him, only for the boy to tip sideways as Ramaswamy staggered and blurted "Whoa! Big guy!" The clip racked up millions of views, drew comparisons to Dukakis in the tank and got roasted by Jimmy Fallon.
items.author: @Acyn
